sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def glyph(frame,r0,c0):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else ('o' if a[r][c]=='P' else '.') for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
def black(g): return tuple(x.replace('o','.') for x in g)
def cursor_col(frame):
    a=frame.ascii.split('\n')
    for r in range(58,62):
        for c in range(12,52):
            if a[r][c]=='W': return c
    return None
print('cursor col now:', cursor_col(current_frame))
cur=[glyph(current_frame,52,15+7*i) for i in range(5)]
for i,g in enumerate(cur): print('slot',i,'now:',g[0],'|',g[1],'|',g[2],'|',g[3],'|',g[4])
def cardglyph(r0,c0):
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return tuple(''.join('#' if a[r][c]=='B' else '.' for c in range(c0,c0+5)) for r in range(r0,r0+5))
cards={'P12':cardglyph(5,23),'P14':cardglyph(5,46),'P22':cardglyph(14,23),'P24':cardglyph(14,46),'P32':cardglyph(23,23),'P34':cardglyph(23,46)}
cycles={}
for slot in range(5):
    # move cursor to slot: from current col
    for _ in range(10):
        cc=cursor_col(current_frame)
        target_col=15+7*slot
        if cc==target_col: break
        action(['RIGHT'] if (target_col-cc)%50>0 and (target_col-cc)%50<25 else ['LEFT'])
    assert cursor_col(current_frame)==target_col, (slot,cursor_col(current_frame))
    c0=target_col
    start=glyph(current_frame,52,c0)
    seq=[start]
    for i in range(12):
        action(['UP'])
        g=glyph(current_frame,52,c0)
        seq.append(g)
        if g==start: break
    assert len(seq)>2, ('cycle too short',slot)
    cycles[slot]=seq[:-1]
    print('slot',slot,'cycle len',len(cycles[slot]))
for i in range(5):
    mem=[n for n,g in cards.items() if black(g) in [black(c) for c in cycles[i]]]
    print('slot',i,'cards in cycle:',mem)
import json
result={'cycles':{str(k):[list(x) for x in v] for k,v in cycles.items()},
        'cards':{k:list(v) for k,v in cards.items()},
        'cur_idx':{str(i):[j for j,c in enumerate(cycles[i]) if c==cur[i]] for i in range(5)}}
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
